veranderings.voor: en die tekens kom by hulle self
veranderings.na: en hulle kry self die tekens
veranderings.rede: "Die tekens kom by hulle self" is wooden; letting the persons be the subject reads naturally and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: lees dan gewoonlik die tekens as
veranderings.na: sien dan gewoonlik die tekens as
veranderings.rede: "Lees ... as" for interpreting signs follows English "read as"; "sien ... as" is the natural Afrikaans and keeps gewoonlik.
"Doen" needs an object here; "dit self te doen" completes the phrase.

veranderings.voor: maande of jare en die tyd
veranderings.na: maande of jare, en die tyd
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: "en" joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb; the protected wording stays intact.

veranderings.na: hoe om hulle uit te ken
veranderings.rede: Telling plants apart is "uitken" in Afrikaans; "hulle te ken" sounds like knowing a person.

veranderings.blok: Erkenning aan die einde van die opleiding
veranderings.voor: leertyd gebeur vandag steeds in Suid-Afrika
veranderings.na: leertyd kom vandag steeds in Suid-Afrika voor
veranderings.rede: A period of training does not "gebeur"; "kom ... voor" is the idiomatic verb and keeps the protected word leertyd.

veranderings.voor: as so 'n roeping gelees, om 'n geneser te word
veranderings.na: gesien as 'n roeping om 'n geneser te word
veranderings.rede: The trailing ", om 'n geneser te word" is detached from "roeping"; joining them and using "gesien as" (not English "read as") reads clearly.

veranderings.na: leer deur saam met die geneser te werk
veranderings.rede: "Saam te werk" leaves unsaid with whom; naming the geneser makes the definition clear when read alone.

vlae.teks: Dat iemand geroep word om 'n bepaalde werk te doen.
vlae.rede: The definition opens with a bare "Dat" clause, which is a sentence fragment; a fix (for example a noun phrase such as "Die gevoel dat...") risks adding content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
